brain.title: The ADHD brain: networks, cortical maturation and MRI findings
brain.description: Animated guide to ADHD brain imaging: networks, a 3-year delay in cortical maturation, small ENIGMA volume differences, and why no scan can diagnose ADHD.

compare.title: ADHD medication effectiveness: effect sizes, children vs adults
compare.description: Cortese 2018 effect sizes and dropout odds for amphetamines, methylphenidate and atomoxetine, an effect-size translator, and blinded non-drug results.

criteria.title: ADHD DSM-5-TR criteria: symptom checklist calculator and ICD-11
criteria.description: Tick the 18 DSM-5-TR ADHD symptoms in a teaching calculator, see the 6 or 5 threshold by age, onset before 12, and how the criteria changed since DSM-IV.

differential.title: ADHD look-alikes: anxiety, autism, bipolar, sleep and co-occurrence
differential.description: How clinicians tell ADHD from anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, autism, sleep apnoea, seizures and trauma, and how often they occur together.

dopamine.title: Dopamine and noradrenaline in ADHD: synapse, inverted U, reward
dopamine.description: How dopamine and noradrenaline work in ADHD: an animated synapse with DAT and NET, the prefrontal inverted U, delay discounting and the PET evidence.

frontiers.title: ADHD research frontiers: centanafadine, devices, neurofeedback, genes
frontiers.description: New ADHD treatments by evidence stage: centanafadine, solriamfetol, EndeavorRx, trigeminal nerve stimulation, neurofeedback, polygenic scores and debates.

genes.title: ADHD genetics: heritability, twin studies and polygenic scores
genes.description: Is ADHD genetic? Twin heritability of 74%, sibling risk, GWAS loci, polygenic scores and rare variants, animated, and why no gene test can diagnose ADHD.

glossary.title: ADHD glossary: 180+ terms from DAT and the inverted-U to PPV
glossary.description: A searchable ADHD glossary of over 180 cited terms, from alpha-2A receptors and delay discounting to Criterion C, the MTA study and drug holidays.

history.title: History of ADHD: from Crichton 1798 to DSM-5-TR
history.description: How ADHD was described and renamed: Crichton, Still, Bradley's Benzedrine, methylphenidate, DSM-II to DSM-5-TR and ICD-11, and how the thresholds changed.

living.title: Living with ADHD: school, work, driving, sleep and pregnancy
living.description: A day with ADHD hour by hour: school and workplace supports, driving risk, sleep, medicines in pregnancy and breastfeeding, family and respectful language.

mta.title: The MTA study of ADHD treatment: 14 months to 16 years explained
mta.description: The MTA trial of 579 children with ADHD: medication, behaviour therapy or both, why the groups converged, the sequencing trial and stopping medication.

nonstim.title: Non-stimulant ADHD medicines: atomoxetine, viloxazine, guanfacine
nonstim.description: How atomoxetine, viloxazine, guanfacine ER and clonidine ER work, how many weeks they take, boxed warnings, side-effect rates and tapering.

nursing.title: ADHD nursing care: baseline checks, NICE monitoring and teaching
nursing.description: ADHD nursing care: baseline height, weight, BP and pulse, the NICE NG87 monitoring schedule, review thresholds, safe storage and patient teaching.

outcomes.title: ADHD in adulthood: persistence, outcomes and medication effects
outcomes.description: Does ADHD persist into adulthood? Persistence by definition, the MTA fluctuating course, injury, crash and mortality risks, and outcomes on vs off medication.

parenting.title: ADHD parent training & classroom support: what the trials show
parenting.description: Behavioural parent training for ADHD explained: AAP and NICE advice by age, blinded effect sizes, daily report cards and organisation skills at school.

quiz.title: ADHD quiz: 99 multiple-choice questions with cited explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on ADHD: prevalence, genetics, brain imaging, DSM-5-TR criteria, stimulants and non-stimulants, the MTA study, outcomes and nursing care.

release.title: ADHD medication formulations: IR vs extended-release daily curves
release.description: How Concerta, Vyvanse, Adderall XR, bead capsules and evening Jornay PM rise and fade over a school day, with label onset, Tmax, duration and doses.

review.title: ADHD flashcards and mnemonics: DSM-5-TR, medicines and NICE monitoring
review.description: 86 cited ADHD flashcards by part, ten memory aids and an animated DSM-5-TR checklist: 18 symptoms, the 6 or 5 threshold, onset before 12, two settings.

risk.title: ADHD causes and risk factors: preterm birth, smoking, myths
risk.description: Which ADHD risk factors survive sibling comparisons, why the youngest in class are diagnosed more often, and what studies say about sugar, vaccines and screens.

safety.title: ADHD medication side effects: growth, heart, misuse and safety
safety.description: ADHD medicine side effects compared with placebo, growth and blood pressure over years, heart, psychosis and tic risks, and stimulant misuse, cited.

scales.title: ADHD rating scales: ASRS, Vanderbilt, SNAP-IV and how assessment works
scales.description: ASRS, Vanderbilt, SNAP-IV, DIVA-5 and QbTest compared, a 1,000-person icon array showing why screeners give false positives, and the full ADHD assessment.

signs.title: ADHD symptoms by age: preschool, school, teens, adults and parents
signs.description: How ADHD looks from age 3 to 60, outwardly and from the inside: inattention persists, hyperactivity fades. Plus a DSM-5-TR teaching tool on impairment.

sources.title: ADHD Companion sources: every reference, validated and searchable
sources.description: Every reference behind the ADHD Companion: journal articles, guidelines, FDA labels and trial registrations, checked against PubMed, Crossref or openFDA.

stimulants.title: How ADHD stimulants work: methylphenidate vs amphetamine
stimulants.description: Animated synapse showing how methylphenidate blocks DAT and NET and amphetamine reverses them via VMAT2, plus lisdexamfetamine, enantiomers and Schedule II.

therapy.title: CBT for adult ADHD, coaching and the non-drug evidence ladder
therapy.description: CBT for ADHD in adults: the Safren trial session by session, plus mindfulness, coaching, neurofeedback, diets and exercise ranked by blinded evidence.

what.title: What is ADHD? How common it is in children and adults, who is missed
what.description: ADHD affects about 5 in 100 children worldwide and many adults. Animated prevalence, boy-girl ratios, persistence to age 25 and US diagnosis versus treatment.

women.title: ADHD in girls and women: why it is missed and diagnosed late
women.description: Why girls with inattentive ADHD are referred less and diagnosed about 4 years later than males, plus sex ratios by setting, hormones and pregnancy.
